hook.name: SatHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook that fully overrides Uniswap v4 swaps with no AMM liquidity: buys mint a SAT token via a forward curve and sells burn SAT via an inverse curve, with ETH reserves accumulated by the hook. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; the hook acts as the sole counterparty and enforces a per-block cooldown between buys and sells.
